svg.title: Red Blue Green Yellow
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Schematic oblique installation view; floor trapezoid represents perspective, not plan geometry. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, green, yellow, blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
